prompt.cubre: Structured logs, correlation, traces, RED or USE metrics, health checks, symptom-based alerts with a runbook link, and separate audit logs.
prompt.campos: timestamp, level, service, environment, version, trace id, event, outcome, duration. User or tenant identifiers are pseudonyms.
prompt.regla: Redact at the logger with an allow-list. A test of a sensitive flow must show that secrets and personal data are absent from the log line.
The same field names apply to the frontend, the backend, workers, and infrastructure.
OpenTelemetry is the default instrumentation shape when the project does not already have one. Do not add a second collector.
